If you are planning a trip to New York City, I highly recommend building your itinerary around a mix of **iconic skyline views, world-class museums, and sprawling green spaces** .

A massive 843-acre oasis right in the center of Manhattan. It is completely free to enter. **What to see:**  Walk past the iconic **Bethesda Fountain** , rent a rowboat at the Loeb Boathouse, or stroll down the elm-lined Mall. **Concierge Tip:**  If you want a break from the crowds, head to the northern end of the park to explore the peaceful **Ramble** or the **North Woods** .

The ultimate symbol of American freedom, gifted by France in 1886. **The Experience:**  You can take a reserved ferry to **Liberty Island** to stand right beneath her, or even climb the 154 steps to the crown if you book months in advance. **Concierge Tip:**  If you are on a tight budget or short on time, hop on the **Staten Island Ferry** . It is completely free and glides right past the statue for fantastic photos.

New York's most famous Art Deco skyscraper.
